name: The Kyo Blog
description: The Palace of My Thougtsh and Researchs.

scripts.blog:build: org2html build content -o dist/blog --include-root includes && node ci/copy-media.mjs && node ci/generate-manifest.mjs dist/blog -o dist/blog-manifest.json --posts-dir dist/posts --base /blog --origin https://kyonax.com
scripts.blog:verify: npm run blog:build && npm run blog:assert && npm run corpus:verify
scripts.corpus:verify: org2html build ci/corpus -o dist/corpus --include-root includes --base-url https://kyonax.com/blog --asset-base /blog && node ci/copy-media.mjs media dist/corpus/media && node ci/assert-build.mjs dist/corpus --corpus --origin https://kyonax.com --base-path /blog && node ci/feature-surface.mjs

author: Cristian D. Moreno - Kyonax
